messages.subject: Change help type in Eclipse Statet
messages.subject_clean: Change help type in Eclipse Statet
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

At the moment my help is opened always in the browser. How can I change
this? Is there a possibility to show the R-help inline in the Statet
help Window? I've seen this in former times. Is this behaviour changed
by default? I've tried to set the options(htmlhelp=FALSE) but it changed
nothing.

Thanks
Christian

messages.subject: Re: Change help type in Eclipse Statet
messages.subject_clean: Change help type in Eclipse Statet
messages.body_plain:
Hi Christian,

do you use R 3.5?

You can repair the help shown in StatET by running

> registerS3method("print", "help_files_with_topic", rj::print.help_files_with_topic)

at startup of the console.

Regards,
Stephan
